name: io.github.StudioPlatforms/aistupidlevel
title: AI Stupid Level
description: LLM benchmark rankings, drift status, incidents and Smart Router previews from AI Stupid Level.

environmentVariables.name: ASL_DATA_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Data API key (asl_live_...) for rankings, history, drift, incidents and provider status. Free key: https://aistupidlevel.info/account/data-keys (10 requests a day, 1 a minute).

environmentVariables.name: ASL_ROUTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Smart Router key (aism_...) for preview_route, ask_router and usage. Create one at https://aistupidlevel.info/router/keys.

environmentVariables.name: ASL_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: true: every Smart Router call returns a mock answer from real routing, so nothing is spent or counted.
